animation_clock.description: the only animation clock in Remotion

interpolate_used.description: tweens via interpolate(frame, range, output, {easing, extrapolate})

easing.description: timing curve; linear only if explicitly intended

sequence_timing.description: Sequence/AbsoluteDelay/Delay for frame-accurate timing; never ms/setTimeout

transitions_preset.description: @remotion/transitions preset at scene seam; never CSS crossfade

async_asset_gate.description: delayRender/continueRender for font/image/audio load; not for fake timing
